opening.argument: The presentation centers on explaining herniated-disc anatomy and demonstrating an exercise position. The speakers describe how a pinched nerve can cause symptoms down the leg, then instruct viewers to lie on their stomach and rise onto their elbows. The mattress giveaway and purchase links are separate commercial promotions, with a possible commission relationship disclosed. A subjective claim of pain relief does not, by itself, establish deception. Nothing in the cited material describes the outcome of a giveaway, reimbursement, or purchase. The observable focus remains physical-therapy education, not a promised commercial result.
